notes.title: Update v1.1 now LIVE!
notes.content:
Price now at 9.99$ which we believe is a very good price considering the amount of content and polish that you get!


Rebuilt entire settings page with animated UI gfx
Settings are now properly saved on the Oculus Rift
Improved ingame Lighting and Shadows handling
Item/Module selection is improved
Landscape destruction is recommended to be turned off on low-end CPU:s
Added seperate information regarding ship speed relating to distance between player and ship.
Made some additional performance improvements
 

Let us know what you think in the forums!

notes.title: Update v1.04 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
So we realized that something that was really needed for new players to quickly get a grip with the game was a Tutorial, so we added one!

The new tutorial is quite extensive and goes through most of the important parts of how the game works and the things you need to pay attention to.
We recommend even seasoned players to try out the tutorial, who knows, there just might be something you missed. :)

Here is a short list of changes:

NEW- Added a very thorough tutorial with shop assistance to quickly get new players up to speed
NEW- Added a tutorial level to for new players to be able to understand the quirks of how to play
GAMEPLAY - Only half the wings are required to build a ship with high rotation
UPDATED- Improved and updated all UI/Menus
IMPROVEMENTS - Improved shipbuilding with a more intuitive solution
BUGS - Some shipbuilding bugs were fixed. 
PERFORMANCE - Game has improved performance in certain heavy areas and levels. 

Adding the tutorial was quite a lot of work but it had to be done and we think you will agree once you try it out!

As always, let us know what you think in the forums!

notes.title: Release Candidate Beta 2 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
EDIT: Release Candidate 2 now available!

We are happy to announce that the first release candidate is now available for testing and feedback! Let us know if you find any critical issue or otherwise that needs to be resolved before the game goes live.

This version contains 99% of all content to be expected in the final version, it is meant for community feedback before exiting out of Early Access. ːsteamhappyː



NEW - New level 1 boss tiles
FIX - Options now include music on/off and level destruction on/off (recommended off for older CPU:s) 
NEW - New level 7
NEW - New boss level 7
NEW - New level 8
NEW - New boss level 8
NEW - 4 new enemy types
NEW - 4 new ship modules you can buy
NEW - Weapon: ION gun, shoots massive blue balls of destruction
NEW - All new ground modules and look for level 1
FIX - Credit placement is lowered in ship menu
FIX - Over 50+ bugs have been squashed
FIX - All bosses now turn red when taking damage
GAMEPLAY - Player is now informed of which level is playing upon entering
GAMEPLAY - Some ship modules are hidden until a certain level is reached
GAMEPLAY - Damage reduced when hitting the ground
GAMEPLAY - Ship is automatically repaired between missions
GAMEPLAY - Player can control ship speed by extending or retracting arm (speed is calculated from the distance to your head)
GAMEPLAY - Enemy bosses take more damage but shoot more
GAMEPLAY - Health drops are more frequent but give less health
GAMEPLAY - Health drops can be from any enemy type or structure
GAMEPLAY - Ship modules are no longer automatically applied, you need to press the trigger to select which connection should be made
GAMEPLAY - Player is informed about adding wings and engines to the ship in the ship menu
NEW- Engine sound from your ship
NEW- Wings now make a small trail when moving
NEW- Player ship now has single health
NEW- Player ship now has a visible health bar
NEW- Player ship now has a visible speed bar
NEW- Bosses now have health bars
NEW- Bosses now have new behaviour
NEW- Bosses now have Shield Modules that must be taken out before they can be destroyed
NEW- Lots of new FX, VFX as well as sounds
NEW- Bosses now have Shield Modules that must be taken out before they can be destroyed
NEW - Added left hand robotic arm which also can pick up powerups and credits as well as providing a small shield for short period of time
NEW - 3D sound on rockets and some enemy missiles
IMPROVEMENTS - New level loading time now only takes a few seconds
IMPROVEMENTS - Chests now rotate and have more visual impacts
IMPROVEMENTS - All enemy and bosses now have exploding sound
IMPROVEMENTS - The ground and everything else is now fully destructible!
PLANNED - TIME TRIAL MODE WITH LEADERBOARD


Tons of more stuff changed but this is the bulk!

This is it folks, let us know what you think and help us find any critical bugs preventing us from releasing the game! 

Thankyou for your patience! ːsteamhappyː

2 new levels

Leaderboard around player and Top 10 in the world

We expect to release the game in about 3-4 weeks, get ready!

notes.title: Update v0.62 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
Update v0.62 is now LIVE!


New: Game modes - Arcade and Free mode!
New: Leaderboard for Arcade mode!
New: Vibration when shooting, feel the vibe!
New: Level! Island levels and volcanoes, what could go wrong?
New: Boss for a new level!
New: Weapon, Gatlin Gun, the most expensive and powerful weapon yet!
New: Lasercannon model!
New: Rocketlauncher model!
New: City tiles, variation is key, right?
New: Billboards for the city!
New: Powerups, Invulnerable, Rapid Fire & Repair! 
New: Enemies now drop coins (credits)!
New: Powerup ship, you know what do when you hear it!
New: End of level summary and destruction bonus!
New: End of level music!
New: Level unlocks, need to beat them to earn them!

Change: Level 3 City tiles will accomodate smaller roomscales
Change: Autofire on all weapons, no more sore fingers
Change: 3500 starting credits
Change. Lasercannon now cost 2k
Change: Rocket laucnher now cost 5k
Change: Gatlin gun cost 10k
Change: Player Ship Health lowered slightly
Change: Lowered credit drop per enemy
Change: Credit drops higher on Arcade

Improved: Minor Lighting and GFX improvements 

Explanation about Arcade Mode: This is meant for the hardcore players who want to show off their skills. The game starts at Level 1 and the 2nd lowest difficulty. The player then progress through the levels one by one with each level considerably more difficult. The game ends at the last Level End-Boss and your score is uploaded to the global Leaderboard.

Explanation about Free Mode: This is more of a free-style mode where you play the game any way you like. It saves the levels you unlock as well as your credits and score so if you die the game will auto Load the latest progress. 

Thanks for your patience and support!

notes.title: What to expect from the coming update
notes.content:
Just to let you folks know that we are not on the lazy side and why this update takes a bit longer than expected. We simply added a bit more content, well, quite a bit more content. Here's the list of additions and changes being worked on:


New: Game modes - Arcade and Free mode!
New: Leaderboard for Arcade mode!
New: Vibration when shooting, feel the vibe!
New: Level! Island levels and volcanoes, what could go wrong?
New: Boss for a new level!
New: Weapon, Gatlin Gun, the most expensive and powerful weapon yet!
New: Lasercannon model!
New: Rocketlauncher model!
New: City tiles, variation is key, right?
New: Billboards for the city!
New: Powerups, Invulnerable, Rapid Fire & Repair! 
New: Enemies now drop coins (credits)!
New: Powerup ship, you know what do when you hear it!
New: End of level summary and destruction bonus!
New: End of level music!
New: Level unlocks, need to beat them to earn them!

Change: Level 3 City tiles will accomodate smaller roomscales
Change: Autofire on all weapons, no more sore fingers
Change: 3k starting credits
Change. Lasercannon cost 2k
Change: Rocket laucnher cost 5k
Change: Gatlin gun cost 10k
Change: Player Ship Health lowered
Change: Lowered credit drop per enemy

Improved: Minor Lighting and GFX improvements 

BugFix:Ship registration issue (after completing a level, ship needs to be reset)(still work in progress) 
BugFix: Bosses can damage themselves(still work in progress) 
BugFix: Environment destruction fails on some tiles(still work in progress) 
BugFix:Module connection point disappears upon undo (regret last)(still work in progress) 
BugFix: Selecting another module does not replace the current one (player forced to place and undo)(still work in progress) 
BugFix: Ship self-destructs when overloaded with missile launchers(still work in progress) 
BugFix: Joints lose connection point if not attached from forward position(still work in progress) 
BugFix: Touch controls may not work properly until game restart(still work in progress) 


Explanation about Arcade Mode: This is meant for the hardcore players who want to show off their skills. The game starts at Level 1 and the 2nd lowest difficulty. The player then progress through the levels one by one with each level considerably more difficult. The game ends at the last Level End-Boss and your score is uploaded to the global Leaderboard.

Explanation about Free Mode: This is more of a free-style mode where you play the game any way you like. It saves the levels you unlock as well as your credits and score so if you die the game will auto Load the latest progress. 

We are pretty eager to release this version but will hold on for a few more days to get rid of the worst bugs. 
As this is more of a content update, the next update will mostly focus on fixxing bugs (new and old!).

Thanks for your patience and support!
